text:
Alexa: Heads up — noticed an invoice delta for yesterday (~0.7% higher tokens charged). Dashboard heatmap points to eu-west between 01:10–01:22 UTC.
Chris: Can you paste the aggregation query you're using? Is this across all models or a subset?
Alexa: Quick check query:
```
SELECT request_id, count(*) FROM metering.events WHERE ts >= '2026-02-28' AND region='eu-west' GROUP BY request_id HAVING count(*)>1;
```
Found ~12k request_ids with duplicates. Dups usually differ by lb_instance_id.
Faizal: Are those retries or duplicate deliveries? Do the events share an X-Request-ID header?
Alexa: yes — same request_id, different upstream_proxy_id. Looks like router retries + duplicate delivery at ingestion.
Sasha: Our current dedupe key in aggregator is (request_id, lb_id) and window=5m. That would treat same logical request hitting a different lb as distinct -> double count.
Faizal: That sounds like the problem. Key should be request_id (and maybe model version). Also 5m window is long; backoffs are generally <2m.
Chris: Risk check: if we dedupe only on request_id, could we drop distinct logical requests if request_id isn't globally unique? Are we certain the gateway stamps a unique request_id per user request?
Alexa: X-Request-ID is stamped at API gateway per logical request and propagated. It's unique per request.
Sasha: Proposal: change dedupe key -> (request_id, model_sha) and reduce window -> 60s. Additionally add ingestion-time tombstone dedupe (fast path) to ignore immediate duplicates.
Chris: Gate rollout behind feature flag + 5% canary in eu-west. Monitor metrics: metering.duplicate_rate, meters.billing_delta, invoices.preview_changed.
Faizal: Also add a metric metering.dedupe_discarded{reason=...} so we can classify dropped events.
Alexa: Patch ready. Migration plan: tombstone table TTL 24h, and a short dedupe window. Deployment snippet:
```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: metering-aggregator
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: aggregator
        env:
        - name: DEDUPE_KEY
          value: "request_id:model_sha"
        - name: DEDUPE_WINDOW_SEC
          value: "60"
```
Sasha: I'll wire the feature flag and test locally. Chris: can you set canary to 5% for eu-west and add alert if duplicate_rate > 0.1% after rollout?
ops-bot: deploy started for metering-aggregator-canary by @Chris
billing-bot: invoice-diff alert: automated reconciliation started; preliminary backfill shows -0.42% change for yesterday
Sasha: Also recommend a backfill to mark duplicates in the past 48h and regenerate invoice previews for affected customers.
Faizal: I'll own the backfill job. Throttle to 100rps, ETA ~6h. Will stream progress here.
Alexa: Action items: Faizal - backfill; Chris - canary rollout + alert; Sasha - patch + migration; Alexa - customer comms prep. :thumbsup:
Chris: Ack. Creating PR and will attach canary dashboard.
Faizal: Starting backfill now (throttled). Posting progress every 30m.
ops-bot: canary deployment reported healthy after 12m :green_heart:
Alexa: Early signal from canary — duplicate_count down ~87% in eu-west canary. :tada:
Chris: If signals hold for 2h with error rates stable, we promote to 100% and run the backfill on the 48h window.
Faizal: Backfill at 40% done, duplicate markers written, no ingestion overload observed.
Alexa: Thanks team — keeping this thread for final postmortem notes and the billing reconciliation results.
